text: Do not speak negatively about yourself. Not even as a joke. Your body does not understand humour. It only understands repetition. Every word you say about yourself is received as an instruction.

When you say, I am stupid, I am weak, I always fail, even laughing while you say it, your body does not laugh. It prepares. Many people are not cursed by life. They are cursed by the way they speak to themselves.

When you speak harshly, the body tightens and the breath turns shallow. When you speak gently, the body softens. The breath deepens. The mind begins to feel safe again. You do not need to shout affirmations.

Just stop wounding yourself with your own mouth. Speak to yourself the way you would speak to a tired friend. Change the way you speak, and slowly your life begins to listen. If you are tired of fighting your own mind, I wrote something for you. Not to fix you.
To help you remember what calm feels like. Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
